findings.message: Hero headline is 11 words ("Your gateway to Chinese factories — with global delivery mad"). Gallery median is 5.
findings.fix: Say the one thing. Move the rest to the supporting line.

findings.message: 5 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Trusted by 60+ global clients" (pill) above "Your gateway to Chinese factories — with"; "Certified & Established" (pill) above "20+ Years of Verified Operations in Chin"; "How we work" above "From inquiry to delivery — our workflow"; "Contact us" above "Book a free consultation"; "FAQ" above "Frequently asked questions"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 9 gradient fill(s): div.relative.h-48 → linear-gradient(to right bottom, oklab(0.978997 -0.020394 0.0050624 / 0.5) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%) | div.pointer-events-none.absolute → linear-gradient(to top, oklab(0 0 0 / 0.1) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%) | div.relative.h-48 → linear-gradient(to right bottom, oklab(0.978997 -0.020394 0.0050624 / 0.5) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 9 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): section#certificate.w-full.bg-white 1440px | section#workflow.w-full.bg-white 1440px | section.w-full.border-t 1440px | section#contact.w-full.border-t 1440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.8:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 48px (3.3vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (it is at 5% opacity).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 1389px of nothing between: "Brands, wholesalers & startups across 15+ countrie"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: 2 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 380px at 9984px; 424px at 10876px (the screen is 844px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone.
